eulalia.definitionKo: 말려서 지붕을 덮는 데나 짐승의 먹이로 쓰이는, 잎이 긴 선 모양이며 키가 큰 풀.

exterminate.englishDescription: For everyone to be killed or to kill everyone.
To catch and then eliminate everything.

feebly.definitionKo: 작은 물체가 가볍게 매달려 있는 모양.
feebly.englishDescription: In a state in which a small object is dangling lightly.
A word describing the manner of moving very quietly or weakly.

feebly.definitionKo: 목숨이나 희망 등이 가는 실같이 작고 보잘것없어 끊어지거나 사라질 듯하게.
feebly.englishDescription: In the state of a life, hope, etc., being fragile and prone to vanish like a thin thread on the verge of breaking.

feebly.definitionKo: 팔다리 등이 힘없이 느리게 자꾸 움직이는 모양. 또는 그렇게 하는 모양.
feebly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of one's arms or legs, etc., moving feebly, slowly in a repeated manner, or making them move in such a manner.
In the state of lacking the energy or desire to do something.

fertilizer.definitionKo: 식물이 잘 자라도록 땅에 뿌리거나 섞는 물질.
fertilizer.englishDescription: Substance scattered over or mixed into the soil for plants to grow well.

fertilizer.definitionKo: 농사를 지을 때 땅을 기름지게 만들어 식물이 잘 자라게 하려고 뿌리는 물질.
fertilizer.englishDescription: A substance for farming that one spreads over soil to make land fertile, and therefore enable crops to grow well.

fictionalize.englishDescription: To write an event or content into a novel.

film.definitionKo: 일정한 의미를 갖고 움직이는 대상을 촬영하여 영사기로 영사막에 비추어서 보게 하는 종합 예술.
film.englishDescription: A composite art which captures moving objects on film with a certain message and then shows it on a screen by using a projector.
(figurative) The act of recalling something flittingly and quickly.
A thin substance covering a surface.

finger-wagging.definitionKo: 상대를 향해 주먹이나 손가락을 힘차게 뻗음.
finger-wagging.englishDescription: An act of stretching out a finger or fist at the other party.

fishery.definitionKo: 바다나 강 등의 물에서 나는 것. 또는 그런 물건.
fishery.englishDescription: A state of coming from the ocean, from a river, etc., or such a thing.
A place where one goes fishing.

fishery.definitionKo: 풍부한 수산 자원이 있고 어업을 할 수 있는 곳.
fishery.englishDescription: A place where there are abundant marine resources and people can engage in fisheries.

fishery.definitionKo: 이익을 얻기 위해 물고기, 조개, 김, 미역 등을 잡거나 기르는 산업. 또는 그런 직업.
fishery.englishDescription: The industry that catches or breeds fish, clam, laver, seaweed, etc. for making money, or such an occupation.

forecast.definitionKo: 앞으로 일어날 일을 미리 알림. 또는 그런 보도.
forecast.englishDescription: The act of predicting and letting people know about what is likely to happen, or such a prediction.
To guess what will happen in the future.

forecast.definitionKo: 무슨 일이 일어날 것이라고 미리 생각하거나 예상하다.
forecast.englishDescription: To think ahead or expect that something may happen.
To predict a future event and announce it to people.

forecast.definitionKo: 앞으로 일어날 일에 대해 미리 생각하고 기다리다.
forecast.englishDescription: To think and expect in advance what is going to happen in the future.

forecast.definitionKo: 앞으로 있을 일이나 상황을 짐작함. 또는 그런 내용.
forecast.englishDescription: The act of guessing what will happen in the future, or something guessed.

forecast.definitionKo: 미래의 일을 알거나 추측하여 말함. 또는 그런 말.
forecast.englishDescription: The act of talking of a future event based upon knowledge or guesswork about it, or such a remark.
To talk of a future event based upon knowledge or guesswork about it.

friend.definitionKo: 사이가 가까워 서로 친하게 지내는 사람.
friend.englishDescription: A person that one is close to and in an amicable relationship with.
The act of making friends, or the friend.
A person who gets along well with another.

friend.definitionKo: 비슷한 나이에 서로 친하게 지내는 사람.
friend.englishDescription: A person of a similar age that one is on good terms with.
(figurative) Something that one always remains close to.

frustration.definitionKo: 바라는 만큼 되지 않아 아깝고 서운한 마음.
frustration.englishDescription: Sad and regretful feelings from not meeting one's expectation.

frustration.definitionKo: 계획한 일이 실패하거나 기대에 어긋났다는 느낌.
frustration.englishDescription: A feeling that a plan has ended in failure or has fallen short of expectations.

frustration.definitionKo: 어떤 행위가 잘 이루어지지 않음을 탄식하는 말.
frustration.englishDescription: A word expressing lament that a certain act has not been accomplished.

frustration.definitionKo: 몹시 억울하고 답답하게 여김. 또는 그런 마음.
frustration.englishDescription: A feeling of great mortification and frustration, or such a state of mind.

The state of being frustrated or enervated.

frustration.definitionKo: 계획이나 의지 등이 꺾여 자신감을 잃은 느낌이나 기분.
frustration.englishDescription: A feeling or mood where one has lost confidence because one's plans, willpower, etc., have been broken.

gadfly.definitionKo: 파리와 비슷하게 생겼으며 소나 말의 피를 빨아 먹고 사는 곤충.
gadfly.englishDescription: An insect that looks like a fly and sucks on the blood of cows and horses.

gardening.definitionKo: 채소, 과일, 꽃 등을 심고 가꾸는 일.
gardening.englishDescription: The process of planting and growing vegetables, fruits, flowers, etc.

gasping.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of repeatedly breathing fast and heavily.

gaya.definitionKo: 한반도의 낙동강 하류에 있던 나라. 42년에 김수로왕과 그 형제들이 세운 여섯 나라를 통틀어 이르는 말이다. 562년에 신라에 병합되었다. 가락국이라고도 한다.
gaya.englishDescription: A country that existed in the lower reaches of the Nakdonggang  River; the Gaya Kingdom is the collective name of the six countries founded by King Kim Suro and his brothers in 42 A.D.; known also by the name of the Garak Kingdom, the country was merged into the Silla Kingdom in 562 A.D.

geuraedo.englishDescription: An abbreviated word for '그리하여도' (a conjugated form of '그리하다' (do so)).
An abbreviated word for '그러하여도' (a conjugated form of '그러하다' (be so)).

gimjangchul.definitionKo: 겨울 동안 먹을 김치를 한꺼번에 많이 만드는 시기.
gimjangchul.englishDescription: The season when people make kimchi for the winter.

glad.englishDescription: Feeling very good and in a good mood.

glad.definitionKo: 보고 싶던 사람을 만나거나 원하는 일이 이루어져서 마음이 즐겁고 기쁘다.
glad.englishDescription: Joyful and happy as one meets a person that one missed.
Feeling good, being happy and glad.

glasses.definitionKo: 시력이 나쁜 눈을 잘 볼 수 있게 하거나 바람, 햇빛 등으로부터 지키기 위해서 눈에 쓰는 물건.
glasses.englishDescription: An object worn over the eyes to help those with poor eyesight see better or to protect them from wind, sunlight, etc.

goenaribojim.definitionKo: (옛날에) 보자기에 싸서 어깨에 메는 작은 짐.
goenaribojim.englishDescription: (archaic) A bundle wrapped in a cloth and carried on one's shoulder.

goodness.englishDescription: The quality or state of being nice and good, or such a thing.

goodness.definitionKo: 무엇을 재촉하거나 무엇이 못마땅할 때 내는 소리.
goodness.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker hurries someone or feels dissatisfied.
The genuineness, goodness, and beauty that human beings pursue.

grape.definitionKo: 달면서도 약간 신맛이 나는 작은 열매가 뭉쳐서 송이를 이루는 보라색 과일.
grape.englishDescription: Purple, small fruits forming a bundle, tasting sweet and a little sour.

groundwater.englishDescription: Stagnant water that is under the ground.

gurglingly.definitionKo: 아직 말을 하지 못하는 아기가 분명하지 않은 말소리를 자꾸 내는 모양. 또는 그 소리.
gurglingly.englishDescription: A word mimicking the sound made when a baby that cannot speak yet makes unclear sounds constantly; such a sound.

guzzler.definitionKo: (낮잡아 이르는 말로) 술을 좋아하고 많이 마시는 사람.
guzzler.englishDescription: (disparaging) A person who likes to drink alcohol and drinks a lot.

ha.definitionKo: 남의 말이나 행동을 가볍게 여겨 비웃을 때 또는 남의 말이나 행동이 마음에 들지 않을 때 하는 말.
ha.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker sneers at someone, thinking little of his/her words or behavior, or when the speaker is displeased with someone's words or behavior.

ha.definitionKo: 남의 말이나 행동을 가볍게 여겨 비웃을 때 또는 남의 말이나 행동이 마음에 들지 않을 때 하는 말.
ha.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when the speaker sneers at someone, thinking little of his/her words or behavior, or when the speaker is displeased with someone's words or behavior.

ha.definitionKo: 매우 아니꼬워 우습거나 기가 막힐 때 내는 소리.
ha.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when something is sickening or funny, or when the speaker is stunned.

ha.definitionKo: 어떤 일이 잘되었을 때나 자기가 생각했던 것과 같을 때 감탄하며 쓰는 말.
ha.englishDescription: An exclamation uttered when something is successful or when a situation turns out to be exactly the way the speaker assumed it would.

ha.definitionKo: 입을 크게 벌려 입김을 한 번 내어 부는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
ha.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the motion of opening one's mouth wide and blowing one's breath on something.

hansik.definitionKo: 한국의 명절의 하나. 동지에서 105일째 되는 4월 6일경이다. 조상의 묘를 찾아가 벌초를 하고 제사를 지낸다.
hansik.englishDescription: One of Korea's traditional holidays; it falls around April 6th, the 105th day from the winter solstice; on this day, people visit the graves of their ancestors, clear the weeds around the grave and hold an ancestral rite.

hapsyo-che.definitionKo: 언어에서, 상대 높임법의 하나로 상대편을 아주 높이는 뜻을 나타내는 종결형.
hapsyo-che.englishDescription: In language, a final form that indicates that the other person is highly respected, as one of the relative honorifics.

health.definitionKo: 몸이나 정신이 이상이 없이 튼튼한 상태.
health.englishDescription: A state of body and mind that is robust with no illness.

hearing.definitionKo: 남이 하는 말의 뜻을 알아듣는 능력.
hearing.englishDescription: The ability to understand the meaning of what others say.
The capacity to hear with one's ears.

hearing.definitionKo: 주로 국가 기관에서, 어떤 문제에 대하여 내용을 듣고 그에 대하여 물어보는 모임.
hearing.englishDescription: A meeting usually held at a governmental institution in which issues are raised and related questions are asked.

hermit.definitionKo: 현실 세계를 떠나 도를 닦으며 사는, 신기한 능력을 가지고 있다는 상상의 사람.
hermit.englishDescription: An imaginary person with miraculous powers who is secluded from the real world and cultivates himself/herself spiritually.
A person who lives alone, hiding from the world.

hermit.definitionKo: 세상에서 일어나는 일을 피하여 숨어서 사는 사람.
hermit.englishDescription: A person hiding from what is happening in the world.

heungbuga.definitionKo: 판소리 다섯 마당의 하나. 조선 고종 때 신재효가 정리한 것으로 심술궂은 형 놀부와 마음씨 착한 동생 흥부에 관한 이야기로 형제 간의 우애와 선악의 문제를 다루었다.
heungbuga.englishDescription: song of Heungbu: One of the five episodes of pansori, Korean storytelling songs; compiled by Shin Jaehyo during the King Gojong's reign in the Joseon Dynasty, the song is a narrative  about a mean and greey person, Nolbu, and his kind-hearted younger brother, Heungbu, focusing on the themes of brotherly love and the contrast of good and evil.

highway.definitionKo: 도시와 도시를 이어 주는 크고 넓은 길.
highway.englishDescription: A large and wide road that connects one city to another.

jaban.definitionKo: 고등어나 굴비 등의 생선을 소금에 절인 것. 또는 그것을 굽거나 쪄서 만든 반찬.
